fusions.name: Let Fly
fusions.desc: Whirls a sling and looses a shot at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full range, with a 20% chance to leave it [Stunned] for 1 second. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Garrote
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Loops a cord round its throat and hauls. It deals 18 damage, leaves the target [Suppressed] for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hand Wraps
fusions.desc: Binds your hands tight and increases your blunt damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Lifter's Sash
fusions.desc: Conjures a wide woven sash: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical damage multiplier rises by 0.15, your maximum health rises by 12, and each kill restores 3 health.
